name: A Dynamite Plan
summary: Sprite Jumpsprocket is eager to put dynamite to work in Stormwind. The inventive tinkerer in the Dwarven District has heard talk of industrial sabotage and wants a supply of coarse dynamite to begin her plan.

sections.title: Sparks in the Dwarven District
sections.body: Sprite Jumpsprocket, a gnome engineer in Stormwind's Dwarven District, welcomes talk of industrial sabotage. Rather than urge caution, she asks passing mercenaries to bring her a bundle of coarse dynamite.

sections.title: Gnomish Ambitions
sections.body: You can make coarse dynamite at an engineering workbench or trade with the city's craftsmen. Sprite asks for ten sticks, enough to disrupt the industrial schemes unfolding in the surrounding territories. Her plan shows the practical, perilous methods gnomes favor when facing mechanical and political disruptions.

faq.answer: Sprite Jumpsprocket is an engineer in the Dwarven District of Stormwind City, among its smithies and workshops. She pursues bold, volatile engineering projects.

faq.q: What does Sprite need for this task?
faq.answer: Sprite needs ten sticks of coarse dynamite. You can make them with engineering or acquire them through trade or the auction house.

faq.q: Why does Sprite want coarse dynamite?
faq.answer: Talk of industrial sabotage has caught Sprite's attention. She wants a stock of basic blasting charges to begin.

faq.q: Where do I turn in the quest?
faq.answer: Sprite Jumpsprocket is in Stormwind City's Dwarven District.

faq.q: Is engineering required to complete this quest?
faq.answer: No, engineering is not required. Engineers can make coarse dynamite, and you can also trade for it or buy it at the auction house.

faq.q: How does this relate to broader troubles around Stormwind?
faq.answer: Sprite does not say what her sabotage targets. She only shows eagerness to begin with dynamite when industrial sabotage comes up.

angles.text: As an engineer, you can make coarse dynamite from coarse blasting powder and linen cloth. It is a straightforward test of early tinkercraft.
As a gnome, you see Sprite Jumpsprocket meet complicated industrial problems with clever, combustible contraptions.
As an Alliance member, you find Sprite's explosive scheme inside the walls of your capital, Stormwind.
